notes.title: Creators, sign up for a Mixture key before the release!
notes.notes:
Creators!

If you stream games on Twitch, record gameplays, reviews and letsplays on YouTube, or do the same even on TikTok, X/Twitter, or elsewhere - feel free to ask us for the Mixture key!

[h3]Fill out the form here: [url=https://forms.gle/1y39W1PK41VyD1178]https://forms.gle/1y39W1PK41VyD1178[/url][/h3]

And wait for our response. Remember, the release is close, so hurry up to be one of the first who will get your hands on the Mixture!

Have a great adventure in the Wastelands!

Mixture is coming out on April 12th, don't forget to wishlist the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133890/Mixture/
